caption.body:
10 export categories to research for 2027.

These are large product groups that appear again and again in India's export data: engineering goods, electronics, steel, plastics, pharma, chemicals, rice, garments, cotton made-ups and marine products. Big does not mean easy for a new exporter, so use this list as a starting point for research, not as a promise.

Pick one group, find its HS code, check demand and competition in your target market, and test with samples before you commit.

leadmagnet.title: Export Research Checklist
leadmagnet.subtitle: Pick a product and test the market before you invest

sections.heading: Pick a product
items: Choose one category from the list
List 3 specific products you can supply
Note your cost, minimum order and lead time

sections.heading: Test demand
items: Search trade data for the HS code (ITC Trade Map, UN Comtrade)
List 10 buyers or distributors in each
Check how many suppliers already sell there

sections.heading: Decide
items: Confirm import and labelling rules with your customs broker
Prepare a sample set and price sheet
Start with one market and one buyer group
